## Report

I looked through the README.md but there's no instructions on how to remove the daemon once it's installed and running, or even, where on the hard disk to find OpenJoystickDriverDaemon.app to delete it.

Basically I installed it, and went through the trouble of making sure the Daemon was working, and that the input test feature shows the joystick. Then I checked to see if it would allow me to perform joystick button remapping. Since it doesn't do that, I don't need it and can't make use of it. But now, I don't know how to clean it out of my system. I figure that's something that belongs in the readme, probably.
